svg.aria-label: Web crawler architecture as a loop with 11 numbered steps: 1 seed URLs go into the URL Frontier; 2 the HTML Downloader takes URLs from it; 3 it resolves hosts with the DNS resolver; 4 the content parser validates pages; 5 and 6 Content Seen? drops pages whose content is already in content storage; 7 the URL extractor pulls out links; 8 the URL filter removes unwanted ones; 9 and 10 URL Seen? checks them against URL storage; 11 only new URLs go back into the frontier.
svg.title: Web crawler architecture
